youtube.title: Newton was the judge in his own calculus beef 🍎 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Leibniz and Newton both invented calculus. Newton's Royal Society "investigated"... and the anonymous report was written by Newton. 💀🍎

Who really invented it? 👇 Drop your answer.

Parody · fictional chat. Based on the real Newton–Leibniz calculus dispute and the Royal Society's 1712 report, which Newton secretly drafted.
